verdict.rationale: Figma's own marketing says its built-in agent generates and refines design directions from prompts, and its MCP server lets agents create and modify native Figma content on the canvas. However, the evidence is marketing-level: no in-depth documentation shows prompt-to-layout or full-mockup output, and there is no hands-on corroboration of the quality of what the tool produces. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on prompt-driven layout and full-mockup generation, explicit documentation of prompt-based editing of existing designs, independent or hands-on corroboration of generated design output.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Use the Figma agent to generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more.
Teammates and AI agents work in the same space with shared context. Generate new design directions, refine, and align—together.
Anyone can edit designs and riff with the agent to refine.
Create and modify native Figma content directly from your MCP client.
enabling agents to write native Figma content back to the canvas
